comparison.objective: Commission a locked-out shock absorber through collar adjustment and guarded dynamic testing, versus joining two loose-cord barrel connectors and laying them down.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires recessed hex-bit engagement, captive-screw torque, collar rotation, socket reacquisition, and response-guided iteration; record requires bimanual alignment and insertion of loose connectors.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two safe cycles within travel, energy, velocity, force, rebound, and drift limits. Record requires specified connector alignment/insertion, release, arm return, and no fall.
comparison.reason: Connector insertion tests loose-part bimanual mating, not adjustment of a locked mechanism followed by measured dynamic commissioning. The record provides numeric insertion tolerances; the difference is functional, not geometric.
